back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“As for you, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then make known to her all her abominations.
Say, the Lord GOD says this: O city that brings on its own time of doom by causing blood to flow within you, and that makes idols to defile itself,

you are guilty because of the blood you have caused to flow, and you are defiled because of the idols you have made. You have brought your days near and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you an object of reproach to the nations and an object of derision to all the lands.
Those near and those far from you will mock you, O city of infamous name, full of turmoil.
Behold, the princes of Israel within you have each used their power to cause blood to flow.
Within you they treat father and mother with contempt; within you they oppress the foreign resident, and they wrong the orphan and the widow.
You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
Within you are slanderers bent on causing blood to flow; within you are those who eat sacrifices on the mountains and commit acts of indecency in your midst.
Within you they uncover what should be covered of their fathers; within you they violate women who are unclean in their menstruation.
One man commits an abomination with his neighbor's wife; another defiles his daughter-in-law with depravity; and another violates his sister, his own father's daughter.
Within you they take bribes to cause blood to flow. You take usury and excessive profit, and you extort your neighbors by oppression; and you have forgotten Me, declares the Lord GOD.
Behold, therefore, I strike My hands together in indignation against the dishonest gain you have made and against the blood shed within you.
Will your heart endure, or will your hands stay strong, in the day I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you throughout the lands, and I will purge your uncleanness completely from you.
You will be defiled in yourself in the sight of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD.”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
Just as a smith gathers silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin into the furnace to blow fire on it to melt it, so I will gather you in My anger and My wrath; I will place you there and melt you.
I will gather you together and blow the fire of My wrath on you, and you will be melted within it.
As silver is melted in the furnace, so you will be melted within it. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you.”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, say to the land, You are a land that has not been cleansed, a land on which no rain has fallen in the day of indignation.
The prophets of the land conspire in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour the lives of people, seize treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.

The priests of the land do violence to My law and profane My holy things. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they do not teach the difference between the unclean and the clean; they shut their eyes to My Sabbaths, and so I am profaned among them.
The officials of the land within her are like wolves tearing their prey, causing blood to flow and destroying lives for dishonest gain.
The prophets of the land whitewash these things with false visions and lying divinations for them, saying, ‘The Lord GOD says this,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
The people of the land practice extortion and robbery; they oppress the poor and needy and exploit the foreign resident without justice.
I sought a man among them who would repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
Therefore I have poured out My indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of My fury; I have brought their ways down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
